summary: Built four mostly-independent primitives and wired their cards: Cultist Infiltrator (Equip cross-controller exception, Straighten-Phase -1C tick via CreateToken, Overlay no-transfer exclusion), Unimpeachable Name (broad out-of-play before-any-action-resolves Reaction, GainHonor loss reduction, Battle ability), Fields of Mercy (per-Terrain destroyed-Personality counter gating DestroyUnits' Personality component; Battle half needed zero new code, reused the existing generic Terrain-play branch), Yasuki Tsujiken (persistent watched-Holding marks, cleared when he leaves play, plus his Open half). All four cards' printed text re-verified against their own scans (Cultist Infiltrator's scraped catalogue text was wrong; corrected via TEXT_OVERRIDE). Wave files renamed to Strategy wave 11/Follower wave 11/Personality wave 20 partway through (originally 10/10/19) after two separate concurrent branches (issues #271/#273/#276) independently claimed those same wave numbers for unrelated cards while this branch was in flight -- reconciled via two merge commits, verified against origin/main's own true current pinned count (324) each time. Crosses into src/L5R.Client/Content/Published/ only to copy the four cards' own generated art via the existing packaging pipeline, the same established cross-lane pattern every prior content wave already uses -- no other UI-lane file touched.
validation: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests: 180/180 core, 57/57 published (pinned count 328, verified against origin/main's own true baseline of 324 + this branch's own 4 cards, not a stale/coincidental match), 9/9 deck-format, 10/10 deck-workshop all passed. bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passes end to end (origin/main's own env.sh fix resolved an earlier local Git Bash quirk this branch hit before merging): python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/collaboration (43 passed), tools/content (130 passed); all four .NET test projects (Core/AI/Server/Client.Transport) green, including L5R.AI.Tests' 10 full simulated matches across 5 seeds with the complete published card pool. docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx regenerated (328 wired) after removing the four now-stale BLOCKERS entries.
remaining: None for the rules-side primitives; ready for review. Explicitly out of scope, flagged for Alfredo/the UI lane in the decision doc: Yasuki Tsujiken's own printed 'visual aid' signifier on a watched Holding, plus the small CardView projection (TsujikenMarks) it would need first.
